AXP.rationale: American Express shows solid fundamental health with consistent revenue and EPS growth (Q1 2026 revenue +9.3% YoY, EPS +17.6% YoY), strong ROE of 33-34%, and healthy net margins of 26.6%. The closed-loop model and premium positioning provide durable competitive advantages, with 153.9M cards in force and 160M merchant locations. Credit quality remains excellent with delinquency rates at 1.4% and charge-offs at 2%. However, operating cash flow declined 20.2% YoY in Q1, and the balance sheet carries elevated debt-to-equity of 1.73. Valuation is mid-range vs own history (P/E 20.7x vs 18.4-25.3x range), not expensive but not a bargain. The TheFork acquisition for $700M is a modest strategic catalyst, and Q2 earnings on July 24 with consensus EPS of $4.37 (+7.1% YoY) provides a near-term event. Competitive pressures from Capital One-Discover merger and Chase Sapphire Reserve refresh are real but manageable given AXP's premium positioning. Overall: good franchise with positive trajectory, fair-to-fair valuation, and a modest near-term catalyst.
